featuredArticle.excerpt: Six names, one struck through, nobody's signature: the morning a dwarf was put in command by a table with pins on it, and the night the wood came through the wall.

latestUpdate.excerpt: 1 Aethel, 922 BF (Feyward clock): Hjumpik is handed six people at breakfast, two of them already dead. The wood comes through the wall. The Revel evacuates its own house and everybody obeys.

didYouKnow: ...that Remi escaped two armed dungeon guards by drawing a goblin face on a cardboard box with a Sharpie marker and claiming to be a certified Box Guardian?
...that the Mount Ebott Survey Part VII file features Sans executing Flowey in a localized time-stop after recalling a midnight tea conversation with King Asgore?
...that Hjumpik recovered the Oracle-marked 'OC' Soul Ring during the Feyward Manor expedition using a garlic grenade and a Bob-omb?

editorialDirective.title: WAH! Editorial Directive — Final Ebott Log:
editorialDirective.text: The oath says silence. The machine says record everything. High Command says stop recording. File the contradiction before anyone calls this mission complete. WAH!
